issues.title: [Tracking] Arena — unreadable-rule census and consolidated repair queue
issues.body:
**Source:** `docs/arena-CURRENT.md`; `docs/arena-testing-progress.md`; `docs/arena-policy-strength.md`; `docs/arena-strategy-validation.md`; `docs/agent-brief.md`.

## Dated baseline
15 October 2026 read-only live snapshot: 6,552 Masters cards and 2,064 Fusion World cards. Arena stores 13,615 Masters skill records: 11,568 draft, 1,985 open/unread, 57 corrected, five confirmed. **1,714 distinct Masters cards initially had unread rules (1,985 skills)**. No unread skills belong to the current 29 saved decks. This does not certify runtime support or strategy.

Offline recompilation at `e486c64b`: no compile errors or missing expected skill records; 31 unread stored skills now compile cleanly. Twenty-two matching-text, no-named-gap records were reviewed and refreshed with readback; nine clean parses remain held for runtime/context or semantic problems. In particular P-616/front/20 incorrectly narrows a total-seven multi-area condition to one energy card; it must not be refreshed.

## Order and hot files
1. Targeted guarded refresh of reviewed compiler-owned records only; preserve all confirmed/corrected/user/Claude rows. Read back and record exact counts.
2. One consolidated issue (this one), as requested by the owner on 15 October. Maintain a full card/face/skill checklist and machine-readable index in the repository; do not create 1,714 separate issues. Group shared compiler mechanics while retaining per-card closure evidence.
3. Prioritize actual requested decks and named release corpus #827, then frequency/shared-mechanic payoff. UI complaints build on the delivered #830/#831 workflow.
4. Ask owner only for missing text or genuinely ambiguous rulings; unsupported parser mechanics are engineering work, not owner homework.

## Acceptance
- [x] Complete machine-readable census and card index are checked in with snapshot timestamp/revision and no private deck data.
- [x] Every unresolved card is present in this issue’s linked complete index, with status and evidence. Additional individual issues are not requested.
- [x] Applied fixes have guarded write/readback receipts and retained test evidence, not blanket approval.
- [ ] Per-card closure proves printed text, manual/Q&A basis (or explicit absence), full clause/cost/trigger behavior and runtime boundaries; update glossary with compiler changes.
- [ ] Guided queue offers a manageable path from this index to the specific skill; owner questions are collected rather than serially blocking unrelated fixes.

Public printed text is captured from the app catalog; no card-specific official Q&A has been fetched in this census. Each implementation must check it or explicitly state its absence before deciding semantics.

**Owner steering, 15 October 2026:** Keep unreadable-card work consolidated in #907. Claude API campaign caps: $20 pilot, $100 inclusive total. No paid calls were made while preparing this plan.

## Delivered census and guarded repairs

- **Remaining: 1,694 cards / 1,963 unread skills**, down from 1,714 / 1,985 after 22 skill refreshes on 22 cards. Twenty cards lost their last unread skill; two retain other gaps.
- 85 owner/Claude-owned records unchanged; 13,593 untargeted programs unchanged; no unexpected differences after readback. Refreshed rules are drafts, not approvals.
- Owner ruling recorded through `arena:rule` for P-514–P-516 and P-588–P-592: **show a compliment, then acknowledge the instruction**. Visible implementation remains open.
- Every affected card/face/skill has printed text, remaining unread clauses, current compilation and triage hints in the complete index. This is a full census, not a claim every unresolved semantic question has been adjudicated.
- P-616/front/20 is a verified unsafe clean parse (seven across four areas becomes one in energy). Hold it and the other eight contextual/runtime cases; do not bulk refresh them.
- Verify the classification/representation of 40 Energy Marker catalog records; keep them in the raw count until reviewed.

## Next repair checklist

- [ ] Repair and fixture-test P-616’s total-seven multi-area condition.
- [ ] Review the remaining eight held clean parses against full costs/triggers/targets and runtime.
- [ ] Implement the eight social promos using the recorded compliment/acknowledgement ruling, with visible evidence.
- [x] Review Energy Marker classification/semantics: #914 merged and production deployment completed. Reminder records remain in the catalog/history, but are excluded from playable-card skill review; raw census counts are historical and are not silently rewritten.
- [ ] Work shared wording/mechanic groups from the linked index, updating per-card status and exact scenario evidence.
- [ ] Link useful grouped review entry points to the delivered #830/#831 workflow; preserve distinct unread/runtime/review/test counts.

[Audit report](https://github.com/uhtred1986-lab/trading-card-management/blob/main/docs/rules-audit-2026-10-15/README.md) · [Complete card checklist](https://github.com/uhtred1986-lab/trading-card-management/blob/main/docs/rules-audit-2026-10-15/cards.md) · [Full machine-readable evidence](https://github.com/uhtred1986-lab/trading-card-management/blob/main/docs/rules-audit-2026-10-15/audit.json)

The remaining catalog count includes **40 Energy Marker entries**; excluding those, **1,654 non-marker cards** still have unread skills.


## Owner-authorized shared-mechanic delivery checklist

The owner requested separate issues for shared fixes during the guided review, while retaining this consolidated card audit. Every group has an issue and delegated implementer. Queued work remains open; dispatch alone never earns closure.

- [x] Energy Marker reminder classification — #914 merged, final combined checks passed, production Vercel deployment completed. Raw historical records preserved.
- [ ] #910 Shenron trait wording — compiler agent; draft PR #912. Separate Power Wish supporting-effect dependencies remain unresolved, so do not auto-close the issue merely for the narrow wording PR.
- [ ] #913 Energy-area EX-Evolve bases — evolution agent, implementing.
- [ ] #915 Bardock’s Crew distinct names across combined areas — compiler agent, queued after Shenron integration.
- [ ] #916 Counter-caused energy reactivation punishment — evolution agent, queued; controller chooses up to one Life and one energy, opponent cannot decline.
- [ ] #917 EX-Evolve activation from Z-Energy — evolution agent, queued as separate source-area extension.
- [ ] #919 Earthling Token counting, cost reductions and Trunks & Mai verification — token agent, implementing. Includes discovered token-name matching gap; other Leader/support gaps explicitly retained.
- [ ] #920 Universe 3 Battle/Combo-to-Drop replacement with owner deck-bottom — replacement agent, assigned.
- [ ] #921 Multicolored-energy conditional BT7 hand discounts — token agent, queued after #919.

**Closure rule:** Every implementation links its issue, canonical evidence and PR. Coordinator reviews the final combined main changes and required checks, verifies production deployment, and records any targeted rule refresh separately. Keep issues open for unmet acceptance or dependencies; update this checklist with delivered scope and evidence. The full census, held unsafe parses and social promo work above remain tracked here.


### Additional groups confirmed during continued review
- [ ] #922 Final Strike Bardock Rest-to-Active Auto: separate broken trigger/chooser dependency found during EX-Evolve validation; no false positive certification.
- [ ] #923 Comprehensive Union audit: all Fusion/Potara/Absorb activation and supporting rules, tracked coverage and focused children #925–#930. Audit implementation must preserve normal play as a separate payment route.
- [ ] #924 Three Gogeta Warp-source Union-Fusion permissions: Union agent; hand/hand, Warp/Warp and mixed sources, equal-power material requirements retained.
- [ ] #933 Three BT13 non-Evolve skill-play restrictions: owner confirmed normal five-energy play remains legal and explicit evolution remains allowed; queued with evolution agent after earlier assignments. Official P-336→BT13-024 FAQ positive required.

**Errata correction to #920:** all four official Permanents replace removal from Battle/Combo irrespective of intended destination, not only Drop. Current catalog text is stale. Implementation uses official errata and preserves banned-card restrictions.


## Current owner priority: saved non-test decks

Owner steering: continue independently using full card/Leader/release context and official rules/Q&A/errata, asking only genuinely unresolved semantic questions. Prioritize existing non-test Masters deck cards over catalog-only groups. Private snapshot contains25such decks and314distinct card IDs; no private deck names, membership lists or owner data are published here.

No unread stored clauses were found in these saved decks, but this is NOT runtime certification. Audit fresh programs, silently narrowed conditions, keyword activation, costs and actual VM behavior. None of the named catalog groups above overlaps this priority set. Finish current reviewable implementation boundaries; hold subsequent catalog-only queued fixes until the saved-deck runtime audit identifies higher-value shared gaps. Existing issue queues remain open.


## Queue paused at owner's request

Owner requested wrap-up because plan usage is nearly exhausted: finish only already running tasks and their review/check/handoff; schedule no further work. Existing issues remain open for the next session.

- Already running implementation boundaries: #913 energy-base Evolve, #920 Universe3 replacements, #924 Gogeta Warp permissions, #937 target-qualified attack restrictions. Finish their checks and draft PRs, then stop.
- #910 Shenron wording and #919 Earthling support are in review; no further implementation added to them.
- Newly identified saved-deck/shared gaps remain queued: #936 attack-negation immunity and hand-qualified play, #938 nested chosen-Cell binding, #939 exact created-token binding, #940 played-or-skill-removal trigger, #941 numeric keyword filters, #942 protected-record application review. No implementation had started for #938/#939 when stopped.
- All earlier queued fixes and comprehensive Union follow-ups remain paused. No automatic resumption, recurring job or paid API campaign was scheduled.

Final closure still requires actual delivered acceptance; an open draft or a saved investigation is not a completed repair. Protected owner/Claude rows remain unchanged.



## Final stop and recovery index

All agents have stopped; queue remains paused. **[Final verified branch/commit/PR/worktree handoff](https://github.com/uhtred1986-lab/trading-card-management/issues/907#issuecomment-6202909173)** lists every unmerged implementation, its checks and remaining steps. All five implementation worktrees are clean and match pushed draft PR heads. Research-only branches are explicitly distinguished. Shenron wording is now merged/deployed; supporting gaps and stored-rule refresh remain open.

issues.title: Arena: build named release deck pairs and ability scenarios with bounded Opus evaluation
issues.body:
Build the next validation increment under #637 from the owner's deck-and-scenario plan in PR #824 (`docs/arena-deck-coverage-plan.md` and the proposed release deck table). The goal is reliable real-deck play and better local-opponent decisions; the release table is a list of candidate recipes, not already validated decks.

## Deliver together

- Assemble the first 16 named candidate decks after checking quantities, restrictions, specified costs and stored-rule readiness. Preserve the existing audited starter controls and explicitly identify any mixed-release support. Record printed card/face/skill coverage, source revisions and blockers. Do not write the owner's live decks without the repository-required data approval; prepare reviewable lists first.
- Grow toward two meaningful decks per booster release. Document exceptions for starter/promotional/special products instead of inventing two legal archetypes. Arena remains Masters only.
- Reuse existing real-card proofs and add the plan's prioritized small scenarios. Every claimed tested skill must have actual scenario/game execution evidence and an independently reviewed expected result. Compilation or merely appearing in a deck is insufficient.
- Run paired seeds/seats locally first; retain private failure replays and public aggregate counts. Record complete, interrupted, decision-limited and crashed games separately.
- Make existing deck naming discoverable with Rename beside the deck title and navigation from the selected arena deck. Reuse ownership-checked persistence; preserve notes, game, cards and built state. Names must appear in selection and offline Update without rewriting historical saved games. Capture before/after browser layouts under the repository's normal UI checks; the owner does not want another physical-phone acceptance test.
- Prepare an Opus adapter using the same restricted observation and legal action IDs as the local policy, a pinned model, cost ledger, per-request reservation and strict run limits. The current proposal is $20/8-game pilot, $100/40-game total first campaign (whichever cap comes first), $3/game and 120 paid decisions/game, with the remaining $100 reserved. Confirm the chosen spend limit before paid execution; knowing the account has $200 is not permission to consume it. Forced actions need no paid call.
- Review mistakes into deterministic engine scenarios, fresh local-policy holdouts or browser-validated UI fixes. Opus is a comparison opponent, not an official rules oracle.

Coordinate with #825 (known current-deck rule gaps) and #826 (resource-aware opponent search). Group related fixes to limit full validation runs; coordinator reviews and merges the combined change.

## General strategic quality and visible progress

White Cell is one example, not the scope of strategic validation. Use the twelve cross-deck benchmark families and frozen comparison protocol in `docs/arena-strategy-validation.md`. Cover aggro, control, materials, recursion, multicolor and Unison play, with acceptable action sets and per-archetype regression guardrails. Also evaluate whether the local AI and Opus use BT31 White Cell effectively. Use `docs/arena-testing-progress.md` as the entry point, the complete release table in `docs/arena-proposed-decks.md`, and the dedicated `docs/arena-white-cell-validation.md` checklist. Distinguish existing leader Auto/energy/privacy proofs from untested full printed-card interactions and strategic decisions. Score legal resource management, Extra choice, evolution/attack sequencing and tactical outcomes, alongside paired-game results. Record cost measurements and progress after each reviewed batch; a deck gate or plausible model explanation is not a pass.

## Delivered by #824

- [x] Persistent admin page via Arena → Testing & stats, with 64 recipe proposals and 55 planned scenarios.
- [x] Evidence-backed progress, actual-deck links and manual results; separate server history and actor/deck/opponent statistics with sample counts and honest unknown costs/model identities.
- [x] Actual testing-deck flags, default-hidden online/local selectors and opt-in toggles.

These deliver the tracker, not assembled/qualified new lists, executed general strategy benchmarks or an automatic paid campaign runner. Continue the work above; do not close this issue on portal delivery alone.

issues.title: Arena: audit every Union variant and its support effects
issues.body:
Owner requested a complete Union audit after reviewing the three Gogeta Warp-material Permanents. Refs #907. This issue tracks shared runtime semantics and all catalog Union references, rather than assuming a clean parse proves playability.

Source: official comprehensive rules 22-13 (all subsections), https://www.dbs-cardgame.com/pdf/rulemanual.pdf?ver_4.00 ; https://www.dbs-cardgame.com/us-en/rule/card_faq.php ; https://www.dbs-cardgame.com/us-en/rule/errata-cards.php ; https://www.dbs-cardgame.com/us-en/rule/keyword-skills.php . Local manual: docs/rules/rulemanual.txt.

Read-only 15 October snapshot: 6,552 Masters cards. 229 cards / 233 faces mention Union. 268 parsed records reference it; 170 actual top-level Union activations (63 Fusion, 51 Potara, 56 Absorb). Two Potara lines are secondary tags beside other keywords and must remain in the inventory. Two Absorb activation records contain unread clauses; many surrounding support/permission/cost/trigger effects are also unread. Counts measure syntax, not complete runtime support.

Rules: Fusion activates from hand, reveals one of each specified character with equal power, sends materials to Drop as cost before additional skill cost, and plays the fusion card. Potara activates from hand, chooses specified characters in Battle, stacks onto both (chosen order), and carries continuous power effects. Expanded Potara sources first move to Battle without area-movement triggers/counter timing. Absorb activates from Battle and follows its printed cost/effect to play the specified card onto the source, carrying position/power effects. All three have explicit failed-entry Drop / return-to-hand exceptions.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Check in complete public card/face/skill inventory, exact text, parser results, unread clauses, and coverage matrix for all three variants plus support references.
- [ ] Audit activation areas, exact named character set and filters, equal power where applicable, material/additional cost order, costs and source permissions, chosen destinations/stack order, carryover, triggers, Counter: Play windows, failed-entry handling, serialized choices and hidden information.
- [ ] Link focused issues for each verified shared gap; distinguish unread, known wrong, supported with proof, and unproven.
- [ ] Review official FAQ/errata and document applied catalog errata and unanswered/absent card-specific rulings.
- [ ] Retain per-family closure evidence; do not close because 168 of 170 activation records compile without unread clauses.

Initial verified gaps: plain-hand Fusion chooser lacks namedSet validation (glossary explicitly admits duplicate same-character selections); Potara chooses its second material after playing onto the first and needs exact-set/order/failure/carryover review; Warp Fusion self-permissions and several Potara/Absorb source extensions unread. Focused issues will be linked as the audit is completed.

Owner clarification: Union is an alternative skill play, not a mandatory replacement for normal play. Unless another printed restriction forbids it, normal energy-cost play from hand remains available without Fusion materials. P-286 normal cost6 versus Union-Fusion cost3 plus qualifying equal-power materials; verify both routes and restrictions. The glossary must explain Fusion, Potara and Absorb separately.

Focused repair queue:

- [x] #925
- [x] #926
- [x] #927
- [x] #928
- [ ] #929

issues.body:
**Source:** `docs/arena-CURRENT.md`; `docs/arena-testing-progress.md`; `docs/arena-policy-strength.md`; `docs/arena-strategy-validation.md`; `docs/agent-brief.md`.

## Outcome
A player can find, start and finish a match against the existing token-free heuristic. Stronger search is a separate evidence-gated improvement, not a prerequisite for exposing the working opponent.

## Execution order and hot files
1. #896: primary Play entry and preparation wording (home/setup UI).
2. #897: qualified pinned corpus and local match runs (packs/evidence); can proceed independently of UI.
3. #898: integrated board/Worker/recovery acceptance after 1+2.
4. #899: strategic improvement in policy/combat/search; retain the shipped heuristic unless promoted.

One writer at a time for home/setup UI, Worker, snapshot and policy boundaries. Coordinate design-system #894, existing rules #825 and release-corpus #827. No deployment is implied by the planning issues.

## Exit
- [ ] Discovery and actual-match acceptance reviewed with evidence.
- [ ] Known runtime and strategy limits visible; no claims based only on compilation.
- [ ] Continuing strategy work links measured results, including negative outcomes. No unread-rule catalog cleanup is required to play the qualified controls.
